title: DOW-UAP-D51, Email Correspondence, Pacific Time Zone, March 2023
doc_notes: This document consists of email correspondence regarding the declassification review of an intelligence report (IIR) concerning a UAP sighting in the Pacific Time Zone in March 2023, with significant portions redacted.

incidents.summary: A civilian reported observing a large blue featureless triangular object hovering near a national security facility, emitting whitish-blue light and moving in a jerking manner.
incidents.quote: large blue featureless triangular object with a solid, unwavering silhouette
incidents.recording_agency: Office of the Undersecretary of Defense for Intelligence and Security
